description: Returns the status of a connection: pending, in_progress, completed (connected) or failed (72 hours without propagation). A connected domain keeps being monitored (read-only): health is healthy, degraded (an optional record is gone, or the zone cannot be read) or broken (a required record is gone), with missing_records listing what is gone.

sandboxToken.description: The auth_token of a sandbox session. Used only when the request carries no credentials; the request then runs against the simulated sandbox provider (no real DNS).

name: get_connection_status
title: Connection status
